static_traits.name: Han Sikai
static_traits.family_status: Lives with parents and a younger sibling
static_traits.social_status: Difficulty building relationships with peers, often Withdrawn due to height insecurity; family is supportive but she finds it hard to talk about insecurity with family
static_traits.medical_history: without significant physical illness; not yet received treatment or counseling for psychological problems
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, acceptable cooperativeness; negative tone, often using catastrophic and black-and-white statements; thinking dominated by comparison and Self-denial; Sleep disturbed from overthinking

basic_info.main_problem: I keep feeling I am not good enough and wish I were taller, which affects my self-esteem and daily life.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these feelings have begun to affect my academic performance and my relationships with peers.
growth_experiences: Since adolescence, comparing height with peers produced inferiority; social pressure and comparison with taller individuals gradually reinforced this insecurity; especially worsened in the past year, triggered almost daily by seeing taller people or having height pointed out, affecting social life, confidence, and mood.

High family support (Living with parents and younger siblings), but the client finds it hard to talk with family about height-related insecurity and shame; this communication difficulty extends to current interpersonal interactions.

core_beliefs: Height determines my worth and how seriously I am taken
I will not succeed or be happy (because of height)

special_situations.event: Seeing many people taller than herself at Social gatherings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not tall enough, I cannot connect with others and will be looked down on
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding socializing activities, reducing contact with peers to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are all judging me because of my height, I am not as good as them

special_situations.event: Someone mentions my height to my face or in jokes
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Once my height is pointed out, it proves I am not worth taking seriously
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Keeping Silence, trying not to talk about personal views and feelings
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will not take me seriously

special_situations.event: Daily sees people taller than oneself on campus or in public places
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Height determines achievement and happiness; if I am not tall enough, my life will fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly compares and overthinks, trying to convince oneself or find proof
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My life is ruined; I will never succeed or be happy

special_situations.event: When facing academic tasks, is distracted by height-related thoughts
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not tall enough, classmates will not accept me, and Learning is meaningless
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduced study effort, procrastinating on tasks
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Nothing I do is of any use

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be taken seriously, accepted, and to have self-worth (not conditional on height)
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being laughed at or rejected because of height, ending up achieving nothing, unable to be loved
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being judged by keeping distance and Avoiding socializing
Attributes difficulties to height to avoid facing deeper vulnerability and shame

object_relations.self_representation: A judged person who is short and not taken seriously / not good enough
object_relations.object_representation: Critical, judgmental others (who may look down on me for my height at any time)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites him to examine the evidence, conduct reality testing, or challenge the belief that 'height determines everything'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client may subconsciously think the counselor is negating her feelings or not understanding her situation
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Repeating the rationale 'height is the key' in an euphemistic but firm way, emphasizing that past attempts were all ineffective, using a low tone to reduce emotional exposure, avoiding deep discussion of individual needs.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing plans to build relationships with others or enter social situations
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client tends to attribute others' negative evaluations to their intentions, believing everyone will look down on her
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizing 'they will laugh at me' in a defensive tone, using hypothetical words (e.g. 'definitely', 'always'), avoiding detailing specific evidence or exceptions.

manifestations: Feeling out of place at Social gatherings and choosing avoidance
Hard to build connections with peers, believes others will judge oneself because of height
Finding it hard to discuss insecurity with family
outcomes: Increased social Withdrawal and sense of isolation

manifestations: Seeing the world through the belief that height determines life worth
Developing 'nothing I do is of any use' thoughts in Learning

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Believing everyone is always judging her for her height in Social situations
Attributing all discomfort in interactions to others' negative intentions

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Repeated comparison and Self-denial, believing 'I do not deserve to be taken seriously'
Overly cautious in interactions, reduces expression and contact

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Unable to discuss height-related insecurity with family, choosing Silence
Suppressing expression impulses in Social situations, turning to Withdrawal and self-reproach

exception_events.target_problem: In Social gatherings, the client usually retreats due to height inferiority, struggles to communicate, and keeps ruminating afterwards.
exception_events.unique_outcome: During one get-together with peers who do not care about height, the client did not Withdraw as usual but joined the interaction, feeling that others were not judging her by height, and stress was markedly reduced.
exception_events.reason: Different support: the people around did not use height as an evaluation standard; different situation: the interaction atmosphere was safe and accepting, shifting her attention from self-comparison to communication.

exception_events.target_problem: In Being alone or around Learning, the client usually gets Distracted by repeatedly thinking about height, affecting Learning engagement.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Once when immersed in a favorite activity, the client did not dwell on height as usual but stayed focused, experiencing more pleasure and less interference.
exception_events.reason: Different approach: investing attention in a concrete task, feeling drawn in by the activity; different situation: the task itself was interesting and challenging, reducing self-focus.

positive_force: Willing to seek help and enter counseling
Able to be engaged and focused in liked activities
Family support exists (though insecurity is hard to talk about)
Having some Learning ability and responsibility (self-reported 'sometimes feeling my Learning is not bad')
negative_force: Catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking are prominent, often Self-denial with statements like 'my life is ruined'
Strong tendencies of comparison and mind reading, excessively cares about others' views
Social avoidance and withdrawal, difficulty expressing needs
Sleep disturbed, scattered attention, Academics affected

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance due to height inferiority
antecedent: Someone mentioning height to one's face
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing and comparative cognitions that directly link height to individual worth, accompanied by mind reading and black-and-white thinking
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the potential threat of being judged and shamed, lowering Anxiety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Increased Interpersonal alienation, worsened Loneliness, further lowering self-esteem and affecting studies and relationships

target_behavior.behavior: Overthinking height issues leading to Sleep disturbed
antecedent: Recalling triggering daytime experiences while Being alone at night
Before studying or resting, thinks of taller people or related comments
target_behavior.core_reason: Negative Anticipation about the future and mental filtering, trying to gain certainty through repeated thinking
target_behavior.function: Trying to control uncertainty and self-soothe (short term), but maintaining the problem
target_behavior.consequence: Declining sleep quality, impaired attention and Academic performance, increased negative emotions
